lines: // Parse an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) into a UTC Date.

content.text:
I fixed the wrong due dates, and `npm test` now passes (1 test, 0 failures).

The bug was in `parseDate` in `src/dates.js`. `Date.UTC` counts months from 0, but the code passed the month from the `YYYY-MM-DD` string as is. Every parsed date landed one month late. An invoice issued Jan 30 with 14-day terms came out due 2026-03-16 instead of 2026-02-13. The fix is `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)`.

`src/report.js` also calls `parseDate`, so its output changes too, and it should now be correct. I didn't check what it does with the date.

The test suite has only this one case. Nothing covers other month or year boundaries.
